APPENDIXA 
Tests of Egyptian versus 
Ptolemaic Bounds 
Competing sets of bounds. To this day there is a debate over which set of 
bounds is appropriate. The choice pits Egyptian against Ptolemy's bounds. 
In designing his own set of bounds, Ptolemy sought to impart a more 
rationally constructed system taking factors like rulership into consideration 
(Ptolemy 1822, 32-36). Table A-l compares both sets of bounds. 
Testing Methodology #1: Directing through the Bounds. Because the 
changeover of Distributors depends on the choice of bounds; one can 
evaluate two sets of Distributors and examine which set produces more 
accurate changeovers which correspond to actual life affairs. For example, 
consider both sets of Distributors for the Midheaven of Teddy Roosevelt. As 
delineated in Chapter 8: Directions and Progressions, the changeover from 
Mercury/Aries to Mars/Aries on 24 March 1912 coincided with Roosevelt's 
reinvigorated Presidential run. The changeover from Mars/Aries to 
Saturn/Aries on 4 December 1916 timed Roosevelt's clash with Wilson over 
Wilson's refusal to approve Roosevelt's request to raise an infantry division 
for WW1 service. 
These dates were based on Egyptian bounds. How do Ptolemy's bounds 
compare? For Egyptian bounds, Mars/Aries and Saturn/Aries begin at 20AR 
and 25AR respectively. For Ptolemy's, 21AR and 26AR; making the 1912 
and 1916 dates about a year later under Ptolemy's set of bounds. By early 
1913, the Bull Moose Party had already risen and flamed out. By late 1917, 
Wilson had already squashed Teddy Roosevelt's infantry idea. If my match 
of events is correct, then the changeovers for Ptolemy's bounds occur a year 
too late. Either my delineation match is wrong or Ptolemy's bounds are 
wrong. 1 side with the latter conclusion though recognize that this type of 
analysis requires further testing on a much wider sample.

Testing Methodology #2: Bound placement of the Luminaries. Because 
the bound ruler imparts its own characteristics to any planet, cusp, or part in 
its bounds, one can evaluate planetary behavior based on both sets of bounds. 
Of all planets, cusps, or parts available for testing, 1 suggest focusing on the 
luminaries. Why? Because they are the most important celestial bodies and 
their manifestation as parents, spouses, and events in the native's own life are 
usually easy to identity and describe. There should be clear evidence of the 
bound's influence on the person or event signified by the luminaries. 
There also exist several aphorisms discussing the impact of bound 
placement on luminaries. As one example, if the Sun falls in the bounds of a 
malefic and the same malefic aspects the Sun without the aspect of a benefic, 
the son will murder the father. Another predicts the goodness of the father if 
the Sun falls in the bound of Jupiter, all the more if Jupiter aspects the Sun. 
(Hand 2001, 52-58). These aphorisms are by no means comprehensive, yet 
are indicative of the power of bounds to modity planetary behavior. Table 
A-3 lists both set of bounds for luminaries of each President. Where they 
differ, the respective bounds are marked by a shaded box.

Procedure for Evaluating Bounds 
The proposed procedure is simple. Compare actual persons signified by 
the Moon (e.g., wife, mother, etc.,) and events with the delineation of the 
Moon placed in both sets of bounds. Evaluate which bound placement is the 
better match and pass judgment. Qualitative in nature, this procedure 
requires expertise in delineation. 
Moon in Capricorn. Common to each of the seven examples is the 
Moon's placement in the sign of Capricorn. What does this signify? Moon 
in Capricorn is in the sign of her detriment. This means the Moon's 
significations of care and nurture do not function well in Capricorn. Instead 
of the ideal archetype of a mother caring and nursing her newborn child (e.g., 
Moon in Cancer where she rules), Moon in Capricorn produces the opposite: 
a Scrooge-like spendthrift. In extreme cases, Moon in Capricorn individuals 
will reduce spending on food to the point of hunger in order to maintain a 
currency stash under the mattress. Other variations include a less extreme 
need for money and status, paying expensive prices for goods, or simply a 
rich woman because Capricorn is the sign of accumulated wealth. 
Bounds of Planets in Capricorn. To these significations of the Capricorn 
Moon, the bound ruler adds its influence. Mercuty/Capricorn adds a mental 
style which is methodical, discerning, keen, serious, and tends to be negative. 
Venus/Capricorn adds the love of status and tradition, those who marry for 
money, and marriage partners with a large age difference. Mars/Capricorn 
adds ambition, self-discipline, military conquest, and a commanding presence 
which is often inflated. Jupiter/Capricorn mxsidkQS wealth and status for true 
wisdom; this frequently manifests as naked ambition. It is also a signature 
common to centralized government and Federalism in American political 
history. Saturn/Capricorn adds the storage and control of accumulated 
wealth and status through walls, castles, corporate and investment trusts, and 
other legal means. 
Dwad. There is no difference of opinion on the definition of dwad. Yet 
because dwad placement also modifies behavior, its effects must be described 
as a control. 
Lincoln's Moon positioned at 25CP11 falls in the bound of Saturn for both 
sets of bounds. Because there is no difference in bound ruler, I omit Lincoln 
from this study. For the influence of bound and dwad on Lincoln's Moon, 
see Chapter 1: Planets in Signs.

APPENDIX A 
Test of Bounds: Chester Arthur's Moon 3CP11 
Egyptian vs. Ptolemy: Mercury vs. Venus 
Dwad = Aquarius 
Mother: Malvina Arthur. Chester Arthur was estranged from both his 
parents because of their aggressive religious proselytizing. Biographer 
Reeves quotes one letter from Arthur's mother written to him during the 
Civil War which implores Arthur to hate sin and obey God's commandments 
among other pronouncements (Reeves 1975: 44-45). Because Mercury 
signifies all things written, the fact that Arthur's mother largely 
communicated with him through letters containing edicts suggests the 
influence of Mercury's bound on the Moon. The serious and negative tone of 
the letters confirms the negative mental influence of the bound ruler. 
Wife: Ellen .Arthur. Ellen Arthur's characterization as an ambitious wife 
fits the Moon's sign ruler Capricorn generally; her depression, bound of 
Mercury/Capricorn; her musical charity events, dwad of Aquarius because 
the humanitarian concern for others is an Aquarian principle. 
Customhouse employees: Moon in 6th (WS) ruling the 12th shows 
mistakes from employee relations; also employee rebellion. The need for 
money expressed by Arthur's customhouse employees matches the Moon in 
Capricorn trait. Money collected through assessments on traded goods in a 
methodical manner is consistent with the Mercury/Capricorn bound. Dwad 
of Aquarius, sign of the water bearer, signifies the proximity of the New 
York Customhouse at the southern tip of Manhattan to nearby shipping docks 
where traded goods were unloaded. 
Event: The Moon-MC primary direction sequence (see. p. 543) timed 
Arthur's intense scrutiny by the Jay Commission established by the newly 
elected President Rutherford Hayes. The description of the Commission as 
fair, discerning, and thorough match both the dwad of Aquarius ('fair') and 
the bound of Mercury/Capricorn ('discerning' and 'thorough') (Reeves 1975: 
144). Its primary concern of excessive payments to employees matches the 
sign placement of the Moon in Capricorn. Direction of the Moon to the 4th 
cusp end-of-the-matter brings Arthur's tenure at the Customhouse to an end.

361 
Test of Bounds: James Monroe's Moon 7CP40 
Egyptian vs. Ptolemv: Jupiter vs. Mercury 
Dwad = Aries 
Wife: Elizabeth Kortright Monroe. Elizabeth Monroe's role in freeing 
Madame Lafayette from prison and her own confinement from illness late in 
life confirm her signification as the Moon in the 12,h in James Monroe's 
figure (WS). The Lafayette incident is of interest. Elizabeth Monroe's 
procurement and outfitting of a carriage for the trip to Madame Lafayette's 
prison smacks of pomp which is a Jupiter/Capricorn signature (Ammon 
1971: 137). Her action was bold and forthright, confirming the Aries dwad. 
Event: White House refurnishing. Monroe's purchase of expensive 
furnishings confirms the need for status of the Capricorn Moon. His 
purchases were over budget, as were Mary Todd Lincoln's in her later White 
House renovation. Monroe selected French Empire furnishings to symbolize 
a strong centralized US government. This choice shows the influence of the 
Jupiter/Capricorn bound. 
Event: Marriage. Monroe's marriage on 16 February 1786 timed by c.s.a. 
Moon conjunct MC on 9 February 1786; highlighted Monroe's need for 
money in order to pay expenses for his new wife and family. Monroe turned 
reluctantly to the law, a profession he espoused little interest, as the fastest 
way to secure a sufficient income (Ammon 1971, 63). Monroe's expedient 
choice of the law profession emphasizes law as the means to an end which is 
the modus operandi of Jupiter/Capricorn.

Test of Bounds: James Buchanan's Moon 11CP28 
Egyptian vs. Ptolemy: Jupiter vs. Mercury 
Dwad = Taurus 
Fiancee: During 1819 Buchanan was engaged to Ann Coleman. 
Coleman's parents accused Buchanan of having an interest more in their 
family fortune than in their daughter. Buchanan's need for wealth in a 
partner and naked ambition that an alliance with a rich family would provide 
match the Moon in Capricorn's placement in the bound of Jupiter/Capricorn. 
Event: Buchcinan's letter to Attorney General Black on 17 November 1860 
requesting a legal opinion on powers of the executive branch amidst the 
South Carolina succession crisis is timed by PT. dex. trine Moon (l=MO) d. 
=> ASC, 8 November 1860. 
Buchanan wrote Black: 
1. In case of a conflict between the authorities of any State and those of the 
United States, can there be any doubt that the laws of the Federal 
Government... are supreme? 
2. What is the extent of my official power to collect duties on imports at a 
port where the revenue laws are resisted by a force which drives the 
collector from the custom house? 
3. What right have I to defend the public property (for instance, a fort, 
arsenal, and navy yard), in case it should be assaulted? 
4. What are the legal means at my disposal for executing those laws of the 
United States which are usually administered through the courts and 
their officers? 
5. Can a military force be used for any purpose whatever under the Acts of 
1795 and 1807, within the limits of a State where there are no judges, 
marshal or other civil officers? (Klein 1995: 359) 
Moon falls in the 7th of legal matters. Buchanan's first question on Federal 
jurisdiction demonstrates Buchanan's overriding concern with Federal 
authority over a rebellious state. Federalism is a Jupiter/Capricorn trait. 
Buchanan's second question concerning import duties matches Moon in 
Capricorn's need for money. The third question matches the Taurus dwad 
because property and real estate is a Taurus signification. 
Though the memo is written in a methodical style consistent with the 
Mercury/Capricorn bound, I suggest the overriding concern of Federal 
authority is a be tter match with Jupiter/Capricorn as bound ruler.

second clue is her function as manager of household products and foods at

confirms the bound because the nature of Capricorn's ruler Saturn is to 
preserve, contain, and store. Dwad of Gemini imparts a Moon in Gemini

I2,h gossip and slander. As First Lady she was subject to constant attention 
by the press; a victim of what is today called paparazzi abuse. She also

death which demonstrates the influence of 12th house secrecy on the Moon's 
position.

who were in arrears on their whiskey tax assessments. Locals protested the

anonymous address was circulated among the troops demanding 
congressional action on promised pension and salary payments. Need for 
money matches the Moon in Capricorn signification. Bound of Venus in 
Saturn's sign of Capricorn arguably fits demands made for pensions because 
pensions are money required in old age.

APPENDIX B 
failed siege of Vienna of 1529 was the high water mark of the threat of 
Turkish influence in Europe, but left a backlash against anything Arabic in its 
wake. European Medieval Astrology was largely purged of Arabic influences 
introduced by 12th century translators, leaving a preference for Ptolemy's 
Greek astrological methods in what Robert Zoller describes as cultural 
revisionism (Zoller 2003: 77-78). Because Ptolemy did not exchange the 
order of the Moon and Sun for nocturnal nativities, his day-only Part of 
Fortune for both diurnal and nocturnal nativities came to dominate the 
European tradition. This influence continues today with students of the late 
Renaissance English astrologer William Lilly; many of whom continue to use 
the day-only formulation as Lilly students. 
Settling the Part of Fortune debate. As always, the relevant question is not 
whether Ptolemy is right or wrong but simply: what works? Because there is 
no debate on the Part of Fortune's construction when sect is diurnal, tests need 
only include nocturnal figures. Before considering testing approaches, it's 
important to remember the Part of Spirit is complementary in construction to 
Part of Fortune. This means that forcing the day-only Part of Fortune on 
nocturnal figures actually mistakes Part of Spirit for Part of Fortune. Testing 
methodologies can take advantage of this difference between Fortune and 
Spirit. 
I suggest three approaches to settle the Part of Fortune debate. 
(1) Part of Fortune as hTlaj. Under rules for choosing the hllaj, the Part of 
Fortune can function as hllaj for some nativities. Because the hllaj is directly 
tied to matters of health and longevity and no author has ever attached these 
matters to the Part of Spirit, a simple test can be constructed. For those 
nocturnal nativities whose Part of Fortune functions as hllaj, evaluate whether 
the diurnal or nocturnal formula better times incidents of illness and death. 
It's probably the most objective test of the three I propose, but does require to- 
the-second accuracy in rectification to test POF primary directions. 
(2) Part of Fortune as a source of wealth. Delineate the Part of Fortune 
under both calculation assumptions. Compare the Part of Fortune's 
delineation by house placement and rulership to actual life affairs for a 
sufficient number of historical figures. Pass judgment on the better match. 
Also test dynamic measurements to Part of Fortune to confirm timing of 
events impacting wealth. 
(3) Part of Spirit as counter example. Because the Part of Spirit is the 
complementary part, one can delineate the Part of Spirit using both diurnal and 
nocturnal formulas. Matching life affairs to the Part of Spirit under one 
consistent set of assumptions confirms the Part of Fortune by counter example. 
This study will begin with the first two tests.

North Node: 15 March 1790 
Following Hamilton's plan for a National Bank and the assumption of state 
debts by the Federal government payable at par, Madison devoted much of his 
time during the summer of 1790 fighting Hamilton's assumption plan. 
Madison did not disagree with assumption per se; only that payment of 
outstanding debt issues at par would unfairly reward speculators at the expense 
of original debt owners who had been forced to sell at distress lev els. 
For Madison, North Node in Sagittarius is placed in the 2nd house of 
wealth. It is conjunct Saturn/Sagittarius and ruled by Jupiter/Taurus/7th. In 
order to match this configuration to Madison's opposition of debt assumption, 
the 2nd must be taken as the 8th from the 7th, or other people's debts. 
Satum/Sagittarius makes Madison a sober judge of other people's debts; 
conjunct the North Node augments this issue for Madison. As ruler of both, 
Jupiter/Taurus - large private speculators - is the source of Madison's 
concern. 
Another North Node delineation is gains in personal financial wealth from 
real estate partnerships which are prudently managed. The North Node period 
was one of the more profitable periods for Virginia planters like Madison. 
Convulsions surrounding the French Revolution increased the demand for and 
prices of American agricultural exports to Europe. 
South Node: 15 March 1793 
South Node in the 8th of investments and foreign trade shows a reduction in 
these affairs. Between 1793 and 1795, both Jefferson and Madison argued that 
the bounty of American exported raw materials could be used as a coercive 
political weapon against other countries. European countries not only 
depended on American raw materials but also the sale of their finished goods 
to Americans to complete the trade flow. Jefferson and Madison suggested 
trade with France as a counterbalance to Britain as a trading partner. 
Madison was unsuccessful with this proposal, frustrated first by reports in 
the Spring of 1794 that American vessels trading with French interests were 
seized by Britain who either condemned them or impounded them until their 
cargos were spoiled in port (e.g., perishable agricultural goods). As the South 
Node Fidaria period finished, George Washington received a copy of Jay's 
Treaty with England on 7 March 1795, considered a sellout to the British by 
Madison. The enmity towards Britain would later come to a head in the War 
of 1812 fought under Madison's own Presidency.

North Node: 28 April 1797 
North Node/Cancer/6th ruled by Moon/Capri com/12 th is a tricky because the

Monroe left France, after his position as envoy was recalled. He was replaced 
by the Federalist Pinckney. Monroe was pro-French, a sentiment not 
supported by Washington, J. Adams, and other Federalists whose party was in 
eclipse. Upon return to America, Monroe launched a bitter attack against 
Pinckney and other Federalists for his recall. Monroe's 500 page A View of 
the Conduct of the Executive in the Foreign Affairs of the United States 
inflamed animosity towards the Federalists by reviving charges the Jay Treaty 
was a sellout to the British (among many other themes). Monroe appears to 
have abetted the Federalist Party's decline with his partisan attack. Voters

fall of 1799 as the period ended. It appears the best delineation of this Nodal-

because of a lack of money. The implication is Monroe establishes a tenant 
relationship to Jefferson who is signified by Sun in 4th of real estate ruling the 
7th of partners, a pivot house from which the 6^ falls away. Another 6th-12th

uprising. Monroe would spend much time during the next year or so dealing 
with nervous constituents and local militias raised to preempt other slave 
rebellions. No other slave rebellions materialized. 12th house is also death of 
children. His son James died in 1801.

North Node: 9 February 1812 
Harrison entered the North Node period fresh from success at repelling the 
Indian attack at the Battle of Tippecanoe on 7 November 1811 Harrison was 
commissioned Major General of the Kentucky militia on 25 August 1812 and 
Brigadier General of the Northwest Territories the following month. Defeat of 
Tecumseh on 5 October 1813 was the culmination of Harrison's military 
service. 
North Node/Libra/10th shows an expanded career/reputation. Ruler 
Venus/Capricorn/1st ruling the 5th of diplomacy signifies land accumulation 
as the source. Defeat of Indians increased safety for settlers in the Northwest 
Territories. 
Things turned sour for Harrison towards the end of the North Node period 
when he quit his post in the spring of 1814. Harrison was reassigned to a 
position further west, where he saw no action. Harrison read this transfer as 
the result of political rivalries between presidential aspirants in the military 
who wanted Harrison out of the picture. 
South Node: 9 February 1815 
Two problems occurred during this period which can be directly related to 
the South Node/Aries/4th and its ruler Mars/Cancer/7th. 
The first was charges of financial impropriety made against Harrison's 
alleged transactions involving commissary supplies brought by former army 
contractor Orr (Cleaves 1939: 232-240). The second was brought by a 
subordinate General Desha and accused Harrison of reluctance to pursue the 
British at Detroit; following only when ordered by Governor Shelby. 
In both of these events, the South Node/Aries/4th is best read as loss in the 
end-of-the-matter. This is different than the 5th house attribute what is said 
about one's career after one is dead. For Harrison, South Node in the 4th 
means that supposedly settled matters are marred by Mars/Cancer/7th. How 
so? Mars/Cancer is usually timid unless threatened; then Mars/Cancer is cruel. 
From details of the Orr incident, Mars/Cancer appears to describe Orr as a 7th 
house party. For the second event, Mars/Cancer accurately describes 
Harrison's reluctant fighting style, making Desha's charges against Harrison 
legitimate. This is also confirmed by Mars as Harrison's Almutem Figuris. 
As the South Node period ended, Harrison was vindicated against Orr's 
charges in a Congressional Committee's final report made on 23 January 1817, 
immediately prior to the end of the South Node period on 9 February 1817. 
Harrison's reputation recovered following the entry into his major Sun period.

North Node: 23 November 1843 
This is an example where the North Node increases the alFairs of a bad 
house to the detriment of the individual. In January 1845, New Hampshire 
Representative John Hale decided to vote against the Texas annexation 
because he could not abide its favoritism to slave owning interests. This 
occurred after the New Hampshire state legislature passed a resolution 
instructing NH Representatives to vote for annexation. Because Pierce was a 
pro-slavery man and head of the state's Democratic political party apparatus, 
he was incensed at Hale's decision and accused him of forcing voters to 
choose between himself and party operatives, thus splitting the party.

to recruit a regiment from New England for service in the Mexican War. At 
the Battle of Contreras, Pierce sustained severe injuries including a fractured 
pelvis and a dislocated left knee. 
Ascendant ruler Moon/Leo shows the need for fame and glory. It rules the 
South Node in the 1st. Following the turmoil of the Democratic Party's 
fortunes, it is no wonder that Pierce saw military service as a vehicle to 
resurrect his political fortunes by continuing the Pierce family tradition of 
seeking glory in battle. South Node in 1st injures the physical body; his 
injuries at Contreras define the entire South Node period. Yet he still manages 
to manufacture notoriety from his very brief war service which proved 
beneficial to him in later election contests.

unexpected death of Levi Woodbury opened up the Presidential race for Pierce 
which he won in November 1852. His major Sun period is maned by his pro- 
Southern warlike philosophy which deepened divisions between the North and 
South. This is shown by Jupiter/Scorpio (expansion of war) ruling 
Sun/Sagittarius.

Node/Scorpio/12th signifies mistakes and increased enmity from 
Mars/Libra/11th political alliances. During the Civil War^ generals unwilling

the signing of the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo ending the Mexican War on 2

which requested President Polk to 'establish whether the particular spot of soil 
on which the blood of our citizens was so shed, was, or was not, our own soil'

father's death and the passage of the Kansas-Nebraska Act on 26 May 1854, is

mundane connection to Lincoln's South Node period. South Node in 6th

This is consistent with Venus/Aries (virulent) ruling South Node

Nebraska Act has been universally cited as a major step in Lincoln's 
radicalization against slavery; it is likely that seeds for his anti-slavery views 
were sown during this South Node period.

From debates against Stephen Douglas to the Presidency, Lincoln achieved 
his greatest fame during the Sun's period.

Mars/Libra/12th, sets the tone for the North Node period.

right to veto, tracing veto power back to 497 BC in a research project which

During the five years of both Nodal periods, Garfield Vv'as involved m 
several financial scandals which harmed his reputation (Peskin 346-371).

First was a scandal he avoided by refusing in late 1871 ar offer from Jay 
Cooke's Northern Pacific Railroad for the position of Land Commissioner. 
Cooke offered Garfield an annual salary of $8,000 plus stock options (present 
terminology) for control of another $100,000 in stock. Garfield was 
suspicious and said no. 
Yet Garfield did succumb to two other questionable financial dealings. 
First was the 1872 DeGolyer influence peddling affair where Garfield 
accepted $5,000 disguised as a payment for legal work in order to push 
through approval for the DeGolyer firm to pave the streets of Washington DC. 
Second was his involvement in the Credit Mobilier scandal to the tune of 
$329. The first was more damaging but blew over as did Credit Mobilier.

24 February 1873 which increased the President's salary by $5,000 and each 
Congressman's by $2,500. As Appropriations Chair, Garfield had to sign it, 
despite his strong reservations. The legislation was pushed through using 
various tricks in order to embarrass Garfield. The public was outraged and the 
measure was quickly rescinded in the next Congressional session. 
North Node/Leo/2nd ruled by Sun/Scorpio/5th promises an increase in 
personal wealth through the Sun's significations of fame/honor. This is a 
signature for influence peddling. As the Sun's ruler, Mars/Scorpio/5th adds 
illicitness to Garfield's personal finances and is consistent with illegal 
financial dealings. 
South Node: 19 November 1873 
Triggered by the failure of Jay Cooke's investment house, the Panic of 
October 1873 ushered in an economic depression second only to the Great 
Depression of 1929-1933. South Node/Aquarius/8th promises loss to 
investments. No such investment losses are mentioned by Peskin; yet there is 
one incident which appears a match. In late 1874, Garfield successfully 
lobbied President Grant against a proposal to implement a public works 
program for the benefit of the unemployed. Jupiter/Aquarius/8th is the logical 
significator for public works because Jupiter/Aquarius signifies a humanitarian 
philosophy. For Garfield, South Node conjunct Jupiter/Aquarius negates 
Jupiter's philosophy.

Arthur's North Node period overlaps the heyday of boss rule of William 
Marcy Tweed during the years 1866-1871. For Arthur, the Presidential

Murphy to the position of NY Customhouse Collector. There Murphy had

tariffs and increased funds available for Arthur's campaign parties.

invest in stocks and bonds with extra cash flow if one is required to fund 
lavish parties at political conventions.

TESTS OF SECT INFLUENCE: PART OF FORTUNE AND F1DARIA 395 
Fidaria 
North Node: 20 August 1872 
In February 1872, Harrison lost the nomination for Indiana Governor due to 
the political machinations of Oliver Morton who as senior Indiana politico 
frustrated Harrison's political career on multiple occasions. Still loyal to the 
state Republican political organization despite this defeat, Harrison spent time 
in the spring and summer of 1872 campaigning for the Republican ticket. In 
August 1872 at the peak of campaign activity, Harrison took a vacation with 
friends, traveling on Lake Erie and down the St. Lawrence River by boat. The 
trip was considered a silent protest against Morton for his role in dumping 
Harrison from the Governor's ticket in February. North Node/Cancer conjunct 
Venus/Cancer in the 5th disposed by Moon/Scorpio/9th describes the trip. As 
the Node's ruler, the Moon is the cause of the trip. Moon/Scorpio/9th shows 
Harrison's need to stew over his political upset by taking a trip, or sabbatical, 
from the 1872 campaign. The North Node/Venus combination describes the 
trip as one made for recreation. Venus/Cancer suggests a comfortable trip. 
With Moon, North Node, and Venus in water signs, Harrison takes a cruise 
(Sievers 1959, 60). In the months after this trip, Harrison devoted more time 
to his daughter Mamie, showering her with clothes, books, and dancing 
lessons. This is another manifestation of North Node/Venus in the 5th 
(Sievers 1959, 64). 
South Node: 20 August 1875 
On 20 August 1875, former President John Adams' diaries were published 
making defamatory comments against William Harrison, Benjamin's 
grandfather. To the 5th house is ascribed what is said after one's death. By 
derived houses, the grandfather is assigned to the 7th because it is the 4th from 
the 4th. 5th from the 7th is the 11th where the South Node by position shows 
insults to Harrison's grandfather after his death. On 1 March 1876, Harrison's 
mother-in-law died; a direct match to the 11th as 8th (death) from the 10th 
(mother) of the 7th (wife). In the fall of 1876, Harrison is reluctantly drafted 
to run for the Indiana Governor's race which he lost on 10 October 1876 to 
'Blue Jeans' Williams. Earlier in the South Node period. Harrison had 
successfully defended a revenue agent on charges of corruption. Coming in 
the midst of the whiskey scandals of the Grant administration, the nation was 
in the mood for a reformer, not a defender of one of the accused. South Node 
in the 11th of politics signifies a lost election. 
Sun: 20 August 1877 
Oliver Morton's stroke of 29 July and death on 1 November 1877 
eliminated Harrison's political rival and allowed Harrison to garner fame as 
the leading Indiana Republican.

North Node: 29 January 1882 
North Node/Capricorn/12th increases affairs of a bad house. Node is 
conjunct Moon/Capricorn and Saturn/Capricorn from which the Moon 
separates. 
Moon/Capricorn ruling the 6th in the 12th signifies slave revolts. (See 
Washington and Monroe for other examples). For McKinley the Moon 
signifies the labor class who clamored for his protectionist trade policies 
designed to support higher prices for workers' domestically produced goods. 
Saturn/Capricorn signifies the protection of accumulated wealth; for McKinley 
business factions in charge of corporate trusts. Ruling both the 12th of 
mistakes/enemies and the 1st of self, Saturn works against McKinley. The 
North Node increases both effects of Moon and Saturn to McKinley's 
disadvantage. 
Kicking off McKinley's North Node period was Congressional debate over 
proposals to lower post-Civil War tariffs which McKinley opposed. Principal

American exports. Profit-maximizing businessmen interested in traded goods 
are a delineation match to Saturn/Capricorn (businessmen as above) ruling 
Mercury/Aquarius (ruled 8th of traded goods). A Tariff Commission Bill was 
signed into law on 15 May 1882 in order to make recommendations on the 
technicalities of tariff policy which it did on 3 December 1882. 
Against McKinley's wishes and Congressional rules which stated all 
revenue bills should come from the House, the Senate superseded 
recommendations made by the Tariff Commission by introducing their own 
legislation for reduced tariffs. The Senate's legislation would have 
substantially reduced tariffs on wool, pig iron, and steel rails (Olcott 1916,

1884. As the North Node period ended, McKinley restated a Republican 
platform that advocated trade protection but admitted the need to correct tariff 
irregularities so long as workers' interests were not harmed.

workers because of their imprisonment over complaints of low wages. As a 
delineation of labor affairs generally and not to McKinley specifically, this is 
an accurate match to the labor strikes of 1886-1887 including the famous 
Haymarket Riot in Chicago of 4 May 1896. Because of the violence, a 
backlash occurred against newly organized labor movements.

North Node/Pisces/10th ruled by Jupiter/Gemini/1st is best delineated as an 
expansion of career/reputation through TR's self-proclaimed status as a jingo. 
Jingoism is a term coined near the turn of the 20th century and used by 
Roosevelt himself. It is a form of chauvinistic patriotism and is a precise 
match to Roosevelt's Jupiter/Gemini/l51 ruled by Mercury/Scorpio/b*. 
Jupiter/Gemini signifies populist rhetoric. The combust Mercury/Scorpio 
signifies a suspicious, caustic mental process which remains hidden to the 
world. Mercury/Scorpio also is the match for TR's famous Speak softly and 
carry a big stick statement because the water sign Scorpio is mute yet it is an 
unforgiving, revengeful, and stinging sign. As ruler of Jupiter, Mercury is the 
source of Roosevelt's jingoism; yet Jupiter is what is heard: Roosevelt was 
said to speak so rapidly that some of his words were lost. 
Roosevelt's historic ascent of the San Juan Hill on 1 July 189S immediately 
followed d. MC sextile North Node on 22 June 1898, the exact date TR arrived 
in Cuba with the Rough Riders.

campaign, Roosevelt traveled widely making hundreds of speeches during the 
summer of 1900 during the Presidential campaign for which he ran on the VP 
slot. Through these speeches, Roosevelt increased his career/reputation.

1901 assassination is a key event but does not appear related to the South 
Node unless the South Node in the 5th by QS placement is accepted. 
The better event match to the South Node period is the May-October 1902 
coal strike, eventually settled on 21 October 1902 just 6 days before the South 
Node period ended. South Node/Virgo/4th can be delineated as diminution of 
farm lands and general problems in the homeland. Mercury/Scorpio/6th as the 
cause is labor problems, in turn triggered by Mars/Capricom/8th as trust- 
busting. Details of this affair are marked by stubbornness, vindictiveness, and 
secrecy consistent with Mercury/Scorpio. While most biographers do not 
detail the nationwide economic impacts of the strike, the mention that schools 
were shut because of a lack of fuel (Pringle 1931: 269) is probably indicative 
of a slowdown of economic activity including farm operations (signification of 
South Node/Virgo/4th), though this needs further research.

Fidaria 
Between 1890 and 1902 Wilson taught at Princeton University. This is very 
early in Wilson's career; few biographers devote substantive space to this 
period. One clue that his University lectures are critical to sort out these nodal 
periods comes from the observation that his lecturers were held on Mondays 
and Tuesdays (Lewis 1952). Based on day rulerships, Moon rules Mondays; 
Mars rules Tuesdays. Moon rules Wilson's South Node/Cancer/1st; Mars 
rules his North Node/Aries/7th. It appears study of Wilson's lecture topics 
will be required to fully sort out these Nodal periods. 
North Node: 29 December 1895 
Several biographers make mention of Wilson's increasing restlessness after 
the spring of 1896 and date his increased interest in politics to this time 
(McKinley 1957, 66). North Node in the cardinal sign of Aries increases 
Wilson's activity to engage the public because it is conjunct Jupiter/Aries in 
the 7th of other people. In 1896, Wilson gave his famous speech "Princeton in 
the Nation's Service" during the University's 150th anniversary celebration. 
There he railed against the ability of science as a course of study necessary to 
train students for public service. Here Jupiter/Aries is Wilson confronting 
open enemies with a head-butting style of preaching. As the cause. Mars is in 
the sign of Aquarius which fights old knowledge and science. Jupiter also 
rules the 6th of service. North Node magnifies this configuration. That it 
favors Wilson is evident with his 1897 professorial appointment to the 
McCormick Chair of Jurisprudence and Politics. 
With North Node in the 7th, some effects should be seen through Wilson's 
wife. In fact, Wilson's wife because interested in Burke and Begehot 
(McKinley 1957, 64) which were two of Wilson's lectures topics made in 
January 1896 just as the North Node began (Link Vol 9., 372-383). 
Some other possible North Node events are Wilson's interest in competitive 
athletics, and his service on a campus discipline committee. 
South Node: 29 December 1898 
South Node/Cancer/1st weakens the physical body. South Node can also 
signify denial. Wilson had his first stroke on 27 May 1896. One physician he 
sought out in 1898 recommended changes in Wilson's diet which had 
previously consisted of a stereotypical Southern meal of fried chicken, greasy 
vegetables, and starches (Weinstein, 149). Al-mubtazz of the South Node is 
Saturn/Cancer which in the bound of Venus/Cancer can be delineated as the 
denial of comfort food.

North Node: 10 August 1913 
[Note: This section recaps discussion in Chapter 12: Lunar Nodes and 
Eclipses.] 
North Node in Taurus ruled by Venus/Virgo signifies fraud, a fall in value, 
out-of-favor investments, poorly run business operations, and the lack of 
Venus-signified foodstuffs because Venus in Virgo is in her fall. Because of 
the unusual configuration with Mercury and Jupiter, Hoover is able to harness 
his business expertise to surmount these difficulties. For details of this 
configuration, See Chapter 6: Temporal Indicators. 
It is during the North Node period that World War I broke out and Hoover 
agreed to head the Belgian Food Relief Efforts on 19 October 1914, one day 
prior to the direction of converse MC trine North Node on 20 October. 
South Node: 10 August 1916 
During the South Node Fidaria period, Germany resumed unrestricted 
submarine warfare and America entered WWI. Several food aid ships were 
sunk in early 1917, reducing monthly food deliveries to Belgium from 150,000 
to 25,000 tons per month. The entry of America into the war meant Hoover 
had to source increased military needs for foodstuffs including what was being 
sent to Belgium. This required a heroic response, to which Hoover adeptly 
responded. 
As ruler of the South Node, Mars/Leo/4th signifies heroics made by people 
in the homeland. Because both France and Belgium are assigned to Leo 
according to Ptolemy's choreography rules, Mars also shows fighting and 
strife in those countries. 
How these effects of Mars cause loss through the South Node in 6th is not 
evident. South Node/6th should show privation to employees and livestock. 
Perhaps the best delineation is sacrifice made by labor because of the heroics 
required to feed both Belgium and American forces fighting in Europe. 
Sun: 10 August 1918 
Armistice is signed shortly after Hoover began his major Sun period. Food 
relief efforts wound down in 1919. By 1921 Harding appointed Hoover to the 
position of Secretary of Commerce; one he would ride to the White House by 
1928.

North Node: 30 January 1921 
Though Roosevelt's contraction of polio dominated the North Node Fidaria 
period, that health incident can be attributed to Distributors and Participators. 
As mentioned in Chapter 8: Directions and Progressions, the Sun's 
Distributor changed to Mercury/Pisces on 19 June 1921, prior to Roosevelt's 
contraction of polio on 10 August 1821. Given the Sun/Aquarius/6th 
delineation as illness from weak circulation in the legs, it appears the Sun's 
entry into the term of Mercury/Pisces made FDR susceptible to polio. In 
addition, his MC distributor changed from Jupiter/Cancer to Saturn/Cancer on 
2 August 1921, 8 days before the illness. 
The better event match to the North Node period appears to be FDR's 
appointment to Vice President to the Fidelity & Deposit Company of 
Maryland. Though trained as a lawyer, FDR did no legal work for them. He 
was a promoter and brought the company clients. FDR was motivated to find 
this position in order to become financially independent of his mother. North 
Node in 4th opposes the 10th of mother. Ruler Jupiter/Taurus in the sign of 
banking and finance match the type of company Roosevelt worked for. That 
FDR successfully helped the firm attract clients shows the influence of Jupiter 
ruling the 7th house.

South Node in 10th means a diminished career and reputation. Widely 
conjunct Mars and ruled by Mercury who tightly separates from Mars, the 
cause of career problems is Roosevelt's overt risk taking and manipulation of 
information. This modus operandi was useful later in political dealings but not 
in business affairs. As a businessman, Roosevelt was prone to making risky 
and unwise investments. This harmed his reputation because Roosevelt 
attached his name to unprofitable business ventures (Black 2003: 151). 
Sun: 30 January 1926 
The Sun period includes FDR's return to politics and election as New York 
Governor when he achieved notoriety for his proposals on hydroelectricity, 
confirmed by d. ASC opposed Sun on 13 March 1929 which timed his 
hydroelectric proposal to the New York Assembly.

North Node: 9 January 1952 
Overall, this was a favorable period for Nixon which included his 
successful Vice Presidential nomination and election to the 1952 Eisenhower 
ticket. North Node/Aries/8th ruled by Mars/Sagittarius/4th suggests an 
increase in campaign contributions caused by blustering verbal attacks. 
Nixon's famous Checkers speech occurred during the North Node period 
which was seen by the largest audience in the history of television up to that 
time. Following the speech, Nixon received over $60,000 in small donations 
to pay for the television spot (Morris 1990: 845). The blusterous verbal attack 
made by the press resulted in Nixon's Checkers defense and an increase in 
public contributions, matching the North Node's 8th house delineation as 
public money because the 8th is 2nd from the 7th. Following Checkers, Nixon 
returned to the campaign trail making heated attacks against the Democrats. 
This matches another Mars/Sagittarius signification as attacks against the 
opposition party because the 4th is 7th from the 10th. 
South Node: 9 January 1955 
Nixon includes Eisenhower's heart attack of 24 September 1955 as one of 
six crises in his first political memoir of the same name (Nixon: 1962). In the 
next six months, Nixon faced a period of duress and indecision caused by 
assessments of Eisenhower's health, whether Eisenhower would run for 
reelection in 1956, and whether Nixon would stay on the ticket. The episode 
culminated with a Dump Nixon campaign immediately prior to the 1956 
Republican National Convention led by Harold Stassen, the President's 
advisor on disarmament. 
To match the South Node/Libra/2nd ruled by Venus/Pisces/7th to these 
events, delineation of the 2nd house as close political advisors (2nd from the 
1st or right hand men) is required. Venus/Pisces/7th is delineated as a 
conciliatory approach to conflict. In later years this would be Nixon's 
signature for detente with the Soviet Union. For this period, Nixon was 
conciliatory towards Eisenhower and did not seek an overt and forthright 
demand for renomination as Vice President. Venus also appears to signify 
Stassen as a 7th house open enemy. Stassen's involvement in arms control 
('sacrifice of military offensive capability in order to keep the peace') makes 
Venus/Pisces signify Staseen. Nixon suggests that John Foster Dulles, a close 
advisor to both himself and Eisenhower, may have contributed to the Dump 
Nixon campaign. This because there was speculation that Dulles and others 
preferred Nixon to take a cabinet post because no other Vice President had 
been elected to the Presidency since Martin Van Buren (Nixon 1962: 161). If 
correct, the loss of political support from advisors is a match to the South 
Node in 2nd.

As a Republican, Ford's Congressional career took a great leap forward 
following Eisenhower's 1952 landslide election which simultaneously gave 
Republicans majority rule of the House. As a member of the appropriations 
committee, Ford was appointed to chair the Army subcommittee on Defense 
Appropriations following the election. 
North Node/Pisces/11th ruled by Jupiter/Capricom/9th indicates an increase 
in political alliances from an ambitious and militaristic foreign policy doctrine. 
During August 1953 Ford made his 1st foreign mission to Korea. There he 
witnessed evidence of Communist expansion in Asia. This trip reinforced his 
political philosophy of the preeminent role that American military power 
should play in policing world affairs. Jupiter/Capricorn in the sign of his fall 
mistakes the ambitious accumulation of wealth and status for the true wisdom 
of Jupiter found in other signs where he has rulership. Because Mars is 
exalted in Capricorn, achieving status through military means is a frequent sub 
theme of Jupiter/Capricorn placements, as Ford's philosophy demonstrates.

to serve on the Intelligence Subcommittee of Appropriations and the 
construction of the Ford's new Alexandria residence. Because operations of 
the Intelligence Subcommittee were classified, there is little to go by in the 
public domain to confirm the influence of the South Node. The known fact 
that the first military advisors were sent to Vietnam on 12 February 1955 and 
that CIA deposed rulers in Congo, Algeria, Turkey, and Guatemala during 
Ford's tenure on the Intelligence Subcommittee do suggest the relevance of 
the South Node in 5th to the death of Kings (8th from the 1 Oth).

Grand Rapids home. As 2nd from the 4th, rental income is a 5th house 
signification. South Node in the 5th promises a diminution of rental income;

possibility that the Ford's had trouble collecting rent requires further research.

during his major Sun period. He was chosen House Minority leader on 4 
January 1965 during the Sun-Jupiter subperiod.

Tests of Egyptian versus 
Ptolemaic Bounds 
Competing sets of bounds. To this day there is a debate over which set of 
bounds is appropriate. The choice pits Egyptian against Ptolemy's bounds. 
In designing his own set of bounds, Ptolemy sought to impart a more 
rationally constructed system taking factors like rulership into consideration 
(Ptolemy 1822, 32-36). Table A-l compares both sets of bounds. 
Testing Methodology #1: Directing through the Bounds. Because the 
changeover of Distributors depends on the choice of bounds; one can 
evaluate two sets of Distributors and examine which set produces more 
accurate changeovers which correspond to actual life affairs. For example, 
consider both sets of Distributors for the Midheaven of Teddy Roosevelt. As 
delineated in Chapter 8: Directions and Progressions, the changeover from 
Mercury/Aries to Mars/Aries on 24 March 1912 coincided with Roosevelt's 
reinvigorated Presidential run. The changeover from Mars/Aries to 
Saturn/Aries on 4 December 1916 timed Roosevelt's clash with Wilson over 
Wilson's refusal to approve Roosevelt's request to raise an infantry division 
for WW1 service. 
These dates were based on Egyptian bounds. How do Ptolemy's bounds 
compare? For Egyptian bounds, Mars/Aries and Saturn/Aries begin at 20AR 
and 25AR respectively. For Ptolemy's, 21AR and 26AR; making the 1912 
and 1916 dates about a year later under Ptolemy's set of bounds. By early 
1913, the Bull Moose Party had already risen and flamed out. By late 1917, 
Wilson had already squashed Teddy Roosevelt's infantry idea. If my match 
of events is correct, then the changeovers for Ptolemy's bounds occur a year 
too late. Either my delineation match is wrong or Ptolemy's bounds are 
wrong. 1 side with the latter conclusion though recognize that this type of 
analysis requires further testing on a much wider sample.

North Node: 15 March 1790 
Following Hamilton's plan for a National Bank and the assumption of state 
debts by the Federal government payable at par, Madison devoted much of his 
time during the summer of 1790 fighting Hamilton's assumption plan. 
Madison did not disagree with assumption per se; only that payment of 
outstanding debt issues at par would unfairly reward speculators at the expense 
of original debt owners who had been forced to sell at distress lev els. 
For Madison, North Node in Sagittarius is placed in the 2nd house of 
wealth. It is conjunct Saturn/Sagittarius and ruled by Jupiter/Taurus/7th. In 
order to match this configuration to Madison's opposition of debt assumption, 
the 2nd must be taken as the 8th from the 7th, or other people's debts. 
Satum/Sagittarius makes Madison a sober judge of other people's debts; 
conjunct the North Node augments this issue for Madison. As ruler of both, 
Jupiter/Taurus - large private speculators - is the source of Madison's 
concern. 
Another North Node delineation is gains in personal financial wealth from 
real estate partnerships which are prudently managed. The North Node period 
was one of the more profitable periods for Virginia planters like Madison. 
Convulsions surrounding the French Revolution increased the demand for and 
prices of American agricultural exports to Europe. 
South Node: 15 March 1793 
South Node in the 8th of investments and foreign trade shows a reduction in 
these affairs. Between 1793 and 1795, both Jefferson and Madison argued that 
the bounty of American exported raw materials could be used as a coercive 
political weapon against other countries. European countries not only 
depended on American raw materials but also the sale of their finished goods 
to Americans to complete the trade flow. Jefferson and Madison suggested 
trade with France as a counterbalance to Britain as a trading partner. 
Madison was unsuccessful with this proposal, frustrated first by reports in 
the Spring of 1794 that American vessels trading with French interests were 
seized by Britain who either condemned them or impounded them until their 
cargos were spoiled in port (e.g., perishable agricultural goods). As the South 
Node Fidaria period finished, George Washington received a copy of Jay's 
Treaty with England on 7 March 1795, considered a sellout to the British by 
Madison. The enmity towards Britain would later come to a head in the War 
of 1812 fought under Madison's own Presidency.

Harrison entered the North Node period fresh from success at repelling the

Things turned sour for Harrison towards the end of the North Node period 
when he quit his post in the spring of 1814. Harrison was reassigned to a 
position further west, where he saw no action. Harrison read this transfer as 
the result of political rivalries between presidential aspirants in the military 
who wanted Harrison out of the picture.

Two problems occurred during this period which can be directly related to 
the South Node/Aries/4th and its ruler Mars/Cancer/7th. 
The first was charges of financial impropriety made against Harrison's 
alleged transactions involving commissary supplies brought by former army 
contractor Orr (Cleaves 1939: 232-240). The second was brought by a 
subordinate General Desha and accused Harrison of reluctance to pursue the 
British at Detroit; following only when ordered by Governor Shelby. 
In both of these events, the South Node/Aries/4th is best read as loss in the 
end-of-the-matter. This is different than the 5th house attribute what is said

Node/Scorpio/12th signifies mistakes and increased enmity from 
Mars/Libra/11th political alliances. During the Civil War^ generals unwilling

the signing of the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo ending the Mexican War on 2

on which the blood of our citizens was so shed, was, or was not, our own soil'

their Southern owners; this triggered a virulent response among Americans. 
This is consistent with Venus/Aries (virulent) ruling South Node

TESTS OF SECT INFLUENCE: PART OF FORTUNE AND F1DARIA 395 
Fidaria 
North Node: 20 August 1872 
In February 1872, Harrison lost the nomination for Indiana Governor due to 
the political machinations of Oliver Morton who as senior Indiana politico 
frustrated Harrison's political career on multiple occasions. Still loyal to the 
state Republican political organization despite this defeat, Harrison spent time 
in the spring and summer of 1872 campaigning for the Republican ticket. In 
August 1872 at the peak of campaign activity, Harrison took a vacation with 
friends, traveling on Lake Erie and down the St. Lawrence River by boat. The 
trip was considered a silent protest against Morton for his role in dumping 
Harrison from the Governor's ticket in February. North Node/Cancer conjunct 
Venus/Cancer in the 5th disposed by Moon/Scorpio/9th describes the trip. As 
the Node's ruler, the Moon is the cause of the trip. Moon/Scorpio/9th shows 
Harrison's need to stew over his political upset by taking a trip, or sabbatical, 
from the 1872 campaign. The North Node/Venus combination describes the 
trip as one made for recreation. Venus/Cancer suggests a comfortable trip. 
With Moon, North Node, and Venus in water signs, Harrison takes a cruise 
(Sievers 1959, 60). In the months after this trip, Harrison devoted more time 
to his daughter Mamie, showering her with clothes, books, and dancing 
lessons. This is another manifestation of North Node/Venus in the 5th 
(Sievers 1959, 64). 
South Node: 20 August 1875 
On 20 August 1875, former President John Adams' diaries were published 
making defamatory comments against William Harrison, Benjamin's 
grandfather. To the 5th house is ascribed what is said after one's death. By 
derived houses, the grandfather is assigned to the 7th because it is the 4th from 
the 4th. 5th from the 7th is the 11th where the South Node by position shows 
insults to Harrison's grandfather after his death. On 1 March 1876, Harrison's 
mother-in-law died; a direct match to the 11th as 8th (death) from the 10th 
(mother) of the 7th (wife). In the fall of 1876, Harrison is reluctantly drafted 
to run for the Indiana Governor's race which he lost on 10 October 1876 to 
'Blue Jeans' Williams. Earlier in the South Node period. Harrison had 
successfully defended a revenue agent on charges of corruption. Coming in 
the midst of the whiskey scandals of the Grant administration, the nation was 
in the mood for a reformer, not a defender of one of the accused. South Node 
in the 11th of politics signifies a lost election. 
Sun: 20 August 1877 
Oliver Morton's stroke of 29 July and death on 1 November 1877 
eliminated Harrison's political rival and allowed Harrison to garner fame as 
the leading Indiana Republican.

North Node: 27 October 1897 
North Node/Pisces/10th ruled by Jupiter/Gemini/1st is best delineated as an 
expansion of career/reputation through TR's self-proclaimed status as a jingo. 
Jingoism is a term coined near the turn of the 20th century and used by 
Roosevelt himself. It is a form of chauvinistic patriotism and is a precise 
match to Roosevelt's Jupiter/Gemini/l51 ruled by Mercury/Scorpio/b*. 
Jupiter/Gemini signifies populist rhetoric. The combust Mercury/Scorpio 
signifies a suspicious, caustic mental process which remains hidden to the 
world. Mercury/Scorpio also is the match for TR's famous Speak softly and 
carry a big stick statement because the water sign Scorpio is mute yet it is an 
unforgiving, revengeful, and stinging sign. As ruler of Jupiter, Mercury is the 
source of Roosevelt's jingoism; yet Jupiter is what is heard: Roosevelt was 
said to speak so rapidly that some of his words were lost. 
Roosevelt's historic ascent of the San Juan Hill on 1 July 189S immediately 
followed d. MC sextile North Node on 22 June 1898, the exact date TR arrived 
in Cuba with the Rough Riders. 
In contrast to Presidential nominee McKinley who ran a front porch 
campaign, Roosevelt traveled widely making hundreds of speeches during the 
summer of 1900 during the Presidential campaign for which he ran on the VP 
slot. Through these speeches, Roosevelt increased his career/reputation. 
South Node: 27 October 1900 
The McKinley-Roosevelt ticket was elected on 6 No\ ember 1900. 
Roosevelt's accession to the Presidency following McKinley's 6 September 
1901 assassination is a key event but does not appear related to the South 
Node unless the South Node in the 5th by QS placement is accepted. 
The better event match to the South Node period is the May-October 1902 
coal strike, eventually settled on 21 October 1902 just 6 days before the South 
Node period ended. South Node/Virgo/4th can be delineated as diminution of 
farm lands and general problems in the homeland. Mercury/Scorpio/6th as the 
cause is labor problems, in turn triggered by Mars/Capricom/8th as trust- 
busting. Details of this affair are marked by stubbornness, vindictiveness, and 
secrecy consistent with Mercury/Scorpio. While most biographers do not 
detail the nationwide economic impacts of the strike, the mention that schools 
were shut because of a lack of fuel (Pringle 1931: 269) is probably indicative 
of a slowdown of economic activity including farm operations (signification of 
South Node/Virgo/4th), though this needs further research.

Between 1890 and 1902 Wilson taught at Princeton University. This is very 
early in Wilson's career; few biographers devote substantive space to this 
period. One clue that his University lectures are critical to sort out these nodal 
periods comes from the observation that his lecturers were held on Mondays 
and Tuesdays (Lewis 1952). Based on day rulerships, Moon rules Mondays; 
Mars rules Tuesdays. Moon rules Wilson's South Node/Cancer/1st; Mars 
rules his North Node/Aries/7th. It appears study of Wilson's lecture topics 
will be required to fully sort out these Nodal periods.

Several biographers make mention of Wilson's increasing restlessness after 
the spring of 1896 and date his increased interest in politics to this time 
(McKinley 1957, 66). North Node in the cardinal sign of Aries increases 
Wilson's activity to engage the public because it is conjunct Jupiter/Aries in 
the 7th of other people. In 1896, Wilson gave his famous speech "Princeton in 
the Nation's Service" during the University's 150th anniversary celebration. 
There he railed against the ability of science as a course of study necessary to 
train students for public service. Here Jupiter/Aries is Wilson confronting 
open enemies with a head-butting style of preaching. As the cause. Mars is in 
the sign of Aquarius which fights old knowledge and science. Jupiter also 
rules the 6th of service. North Node magnifies this configuration. That it 
favors Wilson is evident with his 1897 professorial appointment to the 
McCormick Chair of Jurisprudence and Politics. 
With North Node in the 7th, some effects should be seen through Wilson's 
wife. In fact, Wilson's wife because interested in Burke and Begehot 
(McKinley 1957, 64) which were two of Wilson's lectures topics made in 
January 1896 just as the North Node began (Link Vol 9., 372-383). 
Some other possible North Node events are Wilson's interest in competitive 
athletics, and his service on a campus discipline committee.

South Node/Cancer/1st weakens the physical body. South Node can also 
signify denial. Wilson had his first stroke on 27 May 1896. One physician he

previously consisted of a stereotypical Southern meal of fried chicken, greasy 
vegetables, and starches (Weinstein, 149). Al-mubtazz of the South Node is 
Saturn/Cancer which in the bound of Venus/Cancer can be delineated as the 
denial of comfort food.

North Node: 27 August 1947 
This period covers Johnson's successful Senate election of 3 November 
1948. 
North Node/Cancer/12th increases the affairs of a bad house. They include 
secret enemies and hospitalization. Both marked Johnson's North Node 
period. During the 1948 campaign he was hospitalized for a kidney stone in 
late May 1948. Moon/Virgo as cause suggests sensitivity of his digestive tract 
as cause of the illness. Improper food digestion likely contributed to the 
buildup of stones. 
Truman's Special Message to the Congress on Civil Rights of 2 September 
1948 increased enmity from those opposed to civil rights legislation. 
Venus/Cancer, as read through Truman's own Venus/Cancer/10th, Johnson's 
Venus/Cancer/12th and other American political figures consistently tests as a 
pro-civil rights placement. For Johnson, Venus rules the 10th which ties this 
event to Truman. Dallek gives no substantive details on how this particular 
episode hurt Johnson (Dallek 1991: 288-289) except that he straddled the issue 
by claiming no racial prejudice to proponents of the legislation yet stated his 
continued opposition to Truman's actual legislation to Southern racists in his 
district. 
South Node: 27 August 1950 
Immediately prior to the South Node period, Johnson was named Chair of 
the Senate Preparedness Investigating Subcommittee of the Senate Armed 
Services Committee on 17 July 1950, South Node/Capricom/6th ruled by 
Satum/Aries/9th shows loss to employees because of obstructions to fighting 
foreign wars. Given Johnson's reputation as a slave driver, the workaholic 
Mars/Virgo as the South Node's ruler by exaltation also is key. Johnson's 
Subcommittee produced an (amazing!) 44 numbered reports which concluded 
the Federal government's preparedness against the world-wide Communist 
threat was low, the Munitions Board continued to dispose of critical surplus 
property, and the Defense Department failed to stockpile essential 
commodities. Though Dallek makes no mention during the years 1950-1952, 
it's likely that the workaholic nature of Johnson's subcommittee caused him to 
lose employees. Saturn/Aries/9th, significator of obstructions to foreign wars, 
matches the general tone of the Subcommittee's findings. 
Labor is also a mundane signification of the 6th house. Johnson was critical 
of Truman's April 1952 seizure of the domestic steel industry.

North Node: 9 January 1952 
Overall, this was a favorable period for Nixon which included his 
successful Vice Presidential nomination and election to the 1952 Eisenhower 
ticket. North Node/Aries/8th ruled by Mars/Sagittarius/4th suggests an 
increase in campaign contributions caused by blustering verbal attacks. 
Nixon's famous Checkers speech occurred during the North Node period 
which was seen by the largest audience in the history of television up to that 
time. Following the speech, Nixon received over $60,000 in small donations 
to pay for the television spot (Morris 1990: 845). The blusterous verbal attack 
made by the press resulted in Nixon's Checkers defense and an increase in 
public contributions, matching the North Node's 8th house delineation as 
public money because the 8th is 2nd from the 7th. Following Checkers, Nixon 
returned to the campaign trail making heated attacks against the Democrats. 
This matches another Mars/Sagittarius signification as attacks against the 
opposition party because the 4th is 7th from the 10th. 
South Node: 9 January 1955 
Nixon includes Eisenhower's heart attack of 24 September 1955 as one of 
six crises in his first political memoir of the same name (Nixon: 1962). In the 
next six months, Nixon faced a period of duress and indecision caused by 
assessments of Eisenhower's health, whether Eisenhower would run for 
reelection in 1956, and whether Nixon would stay on the ticket. The episode 
culminated with a Dump Nixon campaign immediately prior to the 1956 
Republican National Convention led by Harold Stassen, the President's 
advisor on disarmament. 
To match the South Node/Libra/2nd ruled by Venus/Pisces/7th to these 
events, delineation of the 2nd house as close political advisors (2nd from the 
1st or right hand men) is required. Venus/Pisces/7th is delineated as a 
conciliatory approach to conflict. In later years this would be Nixon's 
signature for detente with the Soviet Union. For this period, Nixon was 
conciliatory towards Eisenhower and did not seek an overt and forthright 
demand for renomination as Vice President. Venus also appears to signify 
Stassen as a 7th house open enemy. Stassen's involvement in arms control 
('sacrifice of military offensive capability in order to keep the peace') makes 
Venus/Pisces signify Staseen. Nixon suggests that John Foster Dulles, a close 
advisor to both himself and Eisenhower, may have contributed to the Dump 
Nixon campaign. This because there was speculation that Dulles and others 
preferred Nixon to take a cabinet post because no other Vice President had 
been elected to the Presidency since Martin Van Buren (Nixon 1962: 161). If 
correct, the loss of political support from advisors is a match to the South 
Node in 2nd.

North Node: 14 July 1952 
As a Republican, Ford's Congressional career took a great leap forward 
following Eisenhower's 1952 landslide election which simultaneously gave 
Republicans majority rule of the House. As a member of the appropriations 
committee, Ford was appointed to chair the Army subcommittee on Defense 
Appropriations following the election. 
North Node/Pisces/11th ruled by Jupiter/Capricom/9th indicates an increase 
in political alliances from an ambitious and militaristic foreign policy doctrine. 
During August 1953 Ford made his 1st foreign mission to Korea. There he 
witnessed evidence of Communist expansion in Asia. This trip reinforced his 
political philosophy of the preeminent role that American military power 
should play in policing world affairs. Jupiter/Capricorn in the sign of his fall 
mistakes the ambitious accumulation of wealth and status for the true wisdom 
of Jupiter found in other signs where he has rulership. Because Mars is 
exalted in Capricorn, achieving status through military means is a frequent sub 
theme of Jupiter/Capricorn placements, as Ford's philosophy demonstrates.

For the South Node period, Biographer Cannon lists only Ford's invitation 
to serve on the Intelligence Subcommittee of Appropriations and the 
construction of the Ford's new Alexandria residence. Because operations of 
the Intelligence Subcommittee were classified, there is little to go by in the 
public domain to confirm the influence of the South Node. The known fact 
that the first military advisors were sent to Vietnam on 12 February 1955 and 
that CIA deposed rulers in Congo, Algeria, Turkey, and Guatemala during 
Ford's tenure on the Intelligence Subcommittee do suggest the relevance of 
the South Node in 5th to the death of Kings (8th from the 1 Oth). 
Home construction was partly financed by from rental income on Ford's 
Grand Rapids home. As 2nd from the 4th, rental income is a 5th house 
signification. South Node in the 5th promises a diminution of rental income; 
Biographer Cannon does not provide sufficient detail to confirm this. The 
possibility that the Ford's had trouble collecting rent requires further research. 
Sun: 14 July 1957 
Despite Democratic rule under Kennedy and Johnson, Ford's stature rose 
during his major Sun period. He was chosen House Minority leader on 4 
January 1965 during the Sun-Jupiter subperiod.

Mercury in the 1st (house of joy) ruling the 9th makes Reagan the Great 
Communicator of a conservative political philosophy. Why would Mercury 
function as an accidental malefic by timing the Iran-Contra conference? 
Because Mercury separates from Jupiter and Jupiter conjunct South Node in 
the 11th signifies botched Arab alliances. Because Jupiter rules the 12th, these 
alliances are the cause of 12th house mistakes. [Note: See rectification for 
discussion of both Jupiter and Mars primary direction sequences timing arms- 
for-hostages dealings.] If modem planets are considered, Mercury's 
separation from the opposition of Neptune and application to the conjunction 
of Uranus is also problematic. 
As to Mercury's connection with the Canadian Free Trade deal, Mercury 
rules the 9th of foreign affairs. Though there was some controversy about this 
Trade pact from the Canadian side, this event appears less controversial. 
Fidaria 
North Node: 6 February 1950 
The North Node Period was kicked off by special honors given at a black 
tie gala of the Friars Club on 8 February 1950. North Node is placed in the 5th 
whose significations include what is said after one dies. Though living, this 
event followed the termination of Reagan's acting career and was very 
complimentary in tone. 
North Node conjunct Moon in 5th ruling 7th ties also ties the North Node 
period to wife and children. Reagan met Nancy Davis on 15 November 1949 
just before the beginning of period. They were married on 4 March 1952; 
birth of their daughter Patty followed on 22 October 1952. 
South Node: 6 February 1953 
Reagan's fortunes waned as Hollywood actor. South Node in 11th of 
income from the profession shows a salary reduction. In a major step down in 
career, on 15 February 1954, Reagan took the position as emcee for variety 
acts performed at The Continentals Hotel on the Las Vegas strip. 
Sun: 6 February 1955 
Reagan achieved national fame as radio host of the radio program General 
Electric Theatre which started 26 Sep 1954. Shortly after the start of his major 
Sun period, Reagan served as television co-host for Disneyland's 17 July 1955 
grand opening on nationwide television.
